title: Khala Netlify environment contract
description: Documents the browser-public and server-only environment variables the Netlify build and control functions consume. Public variables are safe to inline into the browser bundle; server variables must never reach it. This schema is documentation and a validation reference for infra/netlify/control-store-live-check.ts and the control runtime's own startup checks — Netlify itself does not evaluate JSON Schema.

public.description: Inlined into the browser bundle at build time. Never place a secret here.

PUBLIC_APP_ORIGIN.description: Canonical origin the SPA and OAuth callback are served from. Production is fixed to https://khala.aiur.team; preview deploys use their own Netlify deploy-preview origin.

PUBLIC_HOMESERVER_ORIGIN.description: Origin of the Matrix homeserver the browser SDK connects to for this deploy context.

server.description: Read only inside Netlify Functions request handling, never at module import time, and never echoed into a response, log line, or the browser bundle.

OIDC_ISSUER.description: Issuer origin for the production OAuth/OIDC provider.

OIDC_CLIENT_ID.description: OAuth/OIDC client identifier for this Netlify deploy context.

OIDC_CLIENT_SECRET.description: Confidential OAuth client secret used by the human auth callback (KHA-110).

CONTROL_STATE_NAMESPACE.description: Netlify Blobs store name prefix for control-store records. Distinct per deploy context so preview writes can never collide with or read production control state.

MATRIX_SERVER_NAME.description: Immutable Matrix server name used to derive and validate local user IDs.

MATRIX_REGISTRATION_SHARED_SECRET.description: Synapse shared-secret registration credential. Server-only and identical to the secret rendered into the selected Railway Synapse deployment.

MATRIX_PASSWORD_DERIVATION_SECRET.description: Server-only key used to derive stable per-owner Matrix passwords; passwords are never stored or returned.

INVITATION_HMAC_SECRET.description: Server-only key used to authenticate opaque invitation references.

NETLIFY_BLOBS_CONTEXT.description: Optional explicit override for which control-store namespace this deploy context resolves to. Defaults to inferring from the Netlify deploy context when absent.
